intro: Your force is exposed, the roads are closing, and every hour of delay narrows the route to safety. The slave revolt is growing faster than Rome can understand it. How long do you want to train great men, to slaughter each other in the arena? Arise - 200 gladiators are behind you ! A strong result opens the road to AC073 - Liberation of the surrounding area. Every surviving veteran will matter in the battles ahead, so retreat with purpose and destroy what the enemy cannot be allowed to capture.
